verdict.rationale: Parsec is a SaaS remote-desktop service with user accounts and team data, so data portability is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents no export of user or account data in open formats. API access to audit logs and reporting is an adjacent capability and does not amount to exporting all of a user's data so they can leave.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
